fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: INSTITUTION CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA).

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the effective date for the exchange rates

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: BUYING RATE
fields.description: The indicative buying rate for each particular currency

fields.name: SELLING RATE
fields.description: The indicative selling rate for each particular currency

fields.name: MEAN RATE
fields.description: The mean rate for each particular currency

fields.name: CLOSING BID RATE
fields.description: The closing buy rate for the reporting day

fields.name: CLOSING OFFER RATE
fields.description: The closing sell rate for the reporting day

fields.name: USD CROSS RATE
fields.description: The USD cross rate for each particular currency
